name: dabir
description: Write your LaTeX paper with Claude: a panel beside the chat shows the PDF and every change to keep or undo.
long_description: Dabir brings its paper editor's review into Claude Desktop. Ask Claude to open a paper folder and the Dabir panel appears beside the chat: the compiled PDF, a check that finds LaTeX errors in milliseconds, and every change Claude makes with Keep and Undo for each hunk. The paper recompiles by itself after each edit that holds together. Everything runs on your computer; nothing is uploaded.

tools.name: open_paper
tools.description: Open a LaTeX paper in the Dabir panel

tools.name: read_paper_file
tools.description: Read a .tex or .bib file of the paper

tools.name: edit_paper
tools.description: Replace one passage; the author keeps or undoes it in the panel

tools.name: check_paper
tools.description: Find LaTeX errors in milliseconds, without compiling
